collectables: the pack models only A-side crystal hearts as `crystal-heart` (8 rows); the 16 B-side and C-side hearts appear as `level-clear` rows instead, because collecting them is what clears those sides. The 24 hearts the achievement scope needs are therefore 8 `crystal-heart` rows plus the 16 B/C-side `level-clear` rows, not a single kind

images: guides/celeste/sources/ is gitignored, so the 93 map JPEGs and 11 icons catalogued here are on disk but not in the repo. They must be copied into guides/celeste/images/ and committed before any widget can reference them; which subset and at what resolution is unresolved

notes: First run. Dataset set approved by Pierre 2026-07-29: chapters, checkpoints, strawberry-route, strawberry-pins, collectables, achievements, images.

Pierre's 2026-07-29 call after the join was shown to be unverifiable: keep the strawberries as two datasets sharing the same checkpoint keys rather than assert a pairing. The verified partition (30 A-side checkpoint groups, berry counts agreeing between both sources) is what downstream passes should key on.
The 175 route rows and 175 pin rows independently reproduce the 20/18/25/29/31/47/5 per-chapter split, matching the 175-strawberry "Impress Your Friends" achievement in src-ink-achievements.

Goldens, the winged golden, the 801 roomsanity rooms, 82 binoculars, keys and cars carried by src-tracker-maps are deliberately not extracted — all are out of scope under the 32-achievement definition.
4 strawberry-route rows are flagged where the prose-derived berry type conflicts with the pack's markers; the row's route text is still sound, only its `type` field is in doubt.
Record IDs are minted from stable content keys (chapter/side/berry number for route rows, chapter/side/room for pin rows), never from sequence position, so a re-run reproduces them.
